text.body: namaskṛtya tu taṃ devaṃ śaṅkarasya sutaṃ prabhum yasya prasādāddevasya buddhibhedo'tyabhūnmama 1 avasānaṃ tu vakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ 2 iṣe tvā bhūtāya kukkuṭo'si janayattyai tvā mā bheḥpṛthivi devayajanyadittyai vyundanamaskkannamadyāgnevveragne'dabdhāyo divi vviṣṇuragne vratapate'ndhastyaiṣate ruddra bhāgaḥ svāhā yajñameṣa te gāyatrīvvaruṇasyottambhanamagnestanūḥ sim̐hyasīndraghoṣastvāsim̐hyasi dhruvo'si rakṣohaṇam̐ vvalagahanam̐svarāḍasirakṣohaṇo vo mitrasya mā devīrāpo vvācantesamudraṅgaccha mano me tarppayata svāṅkṛto'syupayāmagṛhīto'syāgrayaṇaḥ somaḥ pavate mitrāvaruṇābbhyāntvātmane me madhave tvāgnaye ttvā mahyaṃyaste'śśvasaniragnaye tvā gāyatracchandasaṃ vreśīnāntvośiktvandevāndivamāpaye svāhāgnirekākṣareṇa mitrovvasavastrayodaśākṣareṇaiṣa te ye devām̐māvirmmaryyā ūrddhvāmārohāgniḥ pṛthuḥ savitrā prasavitrā pṛthivyāḥsadhastthādvasavastvobhayoraditiṣṭvā vasavastvākṛtimagnim 3 viṣṇoḥ tkramaścidasyapāntvāyampuraḥ pañca sajūṛrtubhiranaḍvānvayorājñasyāyurmme pṛthivīcchando'gnirdevatāśustrivṛnnavaviṃśattyāstuvatācchacchandastantunā rāyastrivṛdasi rājñyasi vvirāḍasi samrāḍasisvarāḍasyadhipatryasi sahasrasya ppramā senābhyāśaveśaṅkave śambhavāya parṇāyemā me nṛṣade veḍvājaścasaptaviṃśatiḥ samudro'si svarṇadharmastejo'sipprathamā dvitīyairaśvabbhyāntvā hotā yakṣattsamidhāgnindvādaśāśvinau sarasvatīñcatvāro'gnim̐sviṣṭṭakṛtandevo'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛttvāmaddayāgnaye svāhāhiṅkārāya yate kāyābrahmannadhyāyāntastā ubhāvaśśvastūparo'dhyāyāntaḥśādandadbhirnnavāgneyaḥ kṛṣṇaggrīvastisro brahmaṇe brāhmaṇaṃ saptadaśa sumitriyānaḥ sumitriyā naḥ sumitriyā na edho'sītidve śate catustriṃśadityantyāvasānāni 4 atha tryavasānāni yuṣmā indro'gne brahma sam̐vvapāmi purā krūrasyasavitustvā gandharvvastvopahūto dyaureṣā te vvasubbhyastvā vvedo'syagnirjjyotiḥ saṃhitāsyupahūtā ihaidaṃ dvākūtyai prayuja ūrggasi dve tvamagne'bhittyamadittyāstvā bhaddro me taptāyanī medevasya tvobhayoruddivamattyanyānghṛtenāktau manasta idamāpa aindraḥ pprāṇo māpo'gnervaḥ soma rājannindravāyū ime'yam̐vvām̐yyāvāṅkaśātampratkrathāyam̐vveno dhruvo'si ko'sīndrāgnī āgataṃ pañca sajoṣā indra catasro vvivasvannādittya bṛhasppatisutasyaijatu daśamāsyaātiṣṭṭha tisra uduttyam̐vvi na indreti tisra iha ratiḥ 5 dhruvasadantvā grahā ūrjjāhutaya indrasya vvajro yavoyaste ā mā vvājasyāsmme vaḥ kṣatrasyolbaṃ praparvatasya prajāpate nāśvibbhyāmpacyasva kuvidaṅga purīṣyo'syṛtaṃ sattyamukhāṅkṛṇottvadittyai rāsnāsyūrddhvobhavāgnirmmūrddhā madhuścemaṃ mā dve śukkraśca vviśśvakarmobhayornnabhaśceṣaśca ṣoḍaśī stomo'gniṃhotāramagnettvaṃ tapaśca parameṣṭhī tvobhayornamo'stu tisrāyuryajñena ṛco nāma 6 svāddvīntvā kuvidaṅga yadā pipeṣedaṃ havīreto mūtraṃdṛṣṭvā rūpe niṣasāda nābhirmme trayā devā vadāpo'śvinau cchāgasya pprajāpataye tvāgniḥ paśuḥprāṇāya svāhemā nu kandve'gniścāthaitānaṣṭauyaṅkrandasī ā sute kutastvamadhi no dasrā yuvākavo daivyāvaddharyyū asyedandro brahmaṇaspate'petaḥ syonāpṛthivi bhūrbbhuvo'hāni śandṛte dṛṃha yamāyatvānādhṛṣṭā purastādviśśvāsāṃ bhuvāṃ pate yastestano gāyatrīcchandaḥ samudrāya tvābhīmaṃ payasoretaḥ svāhā prāṇebhyo lomabhyaḥ svāheti śatamekacatvāriṃśadityetāni tryavasānāni 7 atha caturavasānāni pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣo'gnīṣomayorajjitiṃ sajūrddevenendhānāstvā tryambakam̐yyajāmaheṃ'śuraṃśuṣṭe yā te dhāmānyuśmmasi devasya tvāgnīṣomābhyāṃ maruttvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ māhirbhūragnepavasvottiṣṭṭhannojasādṛśramasya ketavo yuvantaṃdevasyāhañjyotiṣmantaṃ prai tu suparṇo'si virāḍjyotirimaṃ sāhasraṃ tisro vāyoḥ pūtaḥ punantu mā pitara edho'si sam̐vvatsaro'syagnimaddyobhayorindrasyaujasttha ṛjave tvā svāhā rudrāya hiraṇmayenapātreṇeti dvātriṃśadityetāni tryavasānāni 8 kṛṣṇo'si namo va uśigasi samudro'simadhumatīrnna iṣaḥ pprāṇāya parameṣṭṭhyabhidhīta indraścaprohyamāṇaḥ somo viśve devā dve'gnirekākṣareṇapūṣā pañcākṣareṇa mitro navākṣareṇa vvṛkṇa ūrmmirartthetastthāveṣṭṭā dandaśūkā dakṣiṇāmāroha pratīcīmudīcīmmūrddhā vayo mā chando'gnerbhāgo'sivasūnām̐yyavānāmekayā stuvata navabhirnavadaśabhiḥ 9 evaśchando'raśminā sattyāya pratipadasi namo hiraṇyabāhave babbhluśāya rohitāya kṛttsnāyatayoṣṇīṣiṇe visṛjadbhyaḥ sabhābhyo gaṇebhyastakṣabhyaḥ śvabhyaḥkapardine hrasvāya jyoṣṭhāya somyāya vannyāya vilmminesruttyāya kūpyāya vāttyāya pāryāya sikattyāya brajyāyaśuṣkkvayāya prathamamagnimadya sūpastthādyetiṣaṭpañcāśadityetāni niravasānāni 10 atha madhyāvasānāni | dvitīyaṃ śarmmāsyagne vvājajidvibhūrasyādade rāvāsidve madhya indrāya tvā bṛhaddvate pañceti madhyāvasānāni 11 atha pañcāvasānāni praitu vāyuranilandve pañcāvasāne 12 atha ṣaḍavasānāni yā te'gne'yaḥ śayā yā te gharmma dve ṣaḍavasāne 13 atha navāvasānāni makhasya śiro'śvasya tvā dve navāvasāne 14 atha maryyādā śatāni caturdaśa trinavatirdvyasānāni 1493 bhavanti dve śate trayastriṃśadantyāvasānāni 233 bhavanti śataṃ pañcāśattryavasānāni 150 bhavanti triṃśaccaturavasānāni 32 bhavanti ṣaṭpañcāśannikhasānāni 56 bhavanti pañca madhyāvasānāni 5 bhavanti dve pañcāvasāne 5 dve ṣaḍavasāne 2 navāvasāne bhavataḥ sarvāṇyavasānānyekīkṛtyaikonaviṃśatiḥ śatāni pañcasaptatiḥ saṃkhyā kaṇḍikāyāścatvāriṃśadadhyāye 1975
